name: aurora-high-acu
title: An Aurora instance is close to its maximum capacity
description: An Aurora instance has used at least 85% of its configured maximum ACU capacity for 45 minutes.
investigation_steps: Open the alarm to identify the affected Aurora instance.
Check database load, connections, query activity and Performance Insights.
Investigate abnormal database activity or consider increasing the configured maximum ACU capacity.
This could lead to service degradation or unavailability if the ACU usage remains high.
Using breakglass to temporarily increase the configured maximum ACU capacity may be necessary to restore service performance while addressing the underlying issue.
